B060-04.notes: Median 86 not a listed score, so x is a middle value: (85+x)/2=86 -> x=87; other placements give medians 81.5-85 or 88.5. Trap C (86).

B060-05.notes: Center (r,r): (2-r)^2+(1-r)^2=r^2 -> r^2-6r+5=0 -> r=1,5; sum 6. Traps A/C (one root).

B060-06.notes: Roots -3±k with 2k=4 -> roots -1,-5 -> c=5. (Or sqrt(36-4c)=4.) Trap C=9 (double root).

B060-07.notes: Must gain 12 h = 720 min; 720/3=240 h = 10 days. Traps D (hours) and C (24-h cycle).

B060-10.notes: Sum 30, sorted a<=b<=7<=d<=e; unique mode 8 forces d=e=8; a+b=7 with a<b (a=b ties mode) and b<7 -> max a=3 (3,4,7,8,8).
